title: Firewatch real time day/night cycle
description:
Real time Firewatch wallpaper that changes the day/night cycle as the day progresses.

[h1]Features[/h1]
This wallpaper includes features such as:
[list]
    [*]A background that changes every 15 minutes to simulate real life day/night cycle accordingly. The wallpaper consists of 96 images. [b]You can choose between 3 background types; the firewatch lake, the firewatch watchtower (distant) and the firewatch watchtower (close-up).[/b]
    [*]Slight particles effect in the background.
    [*]Clock - both 24 hour and 12 hour support and support for country specific date translations.
    [*]Current weather temperature (both celsius and fahrenheit support). The temperature updates every third hour. Remember to enter your own location/city when the wallpaper has been downloaded. [b]This feature has to be enabled in the settings.[/b] If you choose to enter your own API key, the temperature updates every minute. Signing up for an API key can be done here: [url=https://home.openweathermap.org/api_keys]OpenWeatherMap[/url]. [b]Keep in mind that it will take a few hours for the key to be activated by OpenWeatherMap - be patient.[/b]
    [*]Firewatch's prologue song playing in the background (can be enabled/disabled).
[/list]


If you enjoy this wallpaper and would like to support its ongoing development and maintenance, please consider making a donation - either by [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/aDJSwI9Hj]Buying Me A Coffee[/url] or by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/tradeoffer/new/?partner=6980515&token=v0N0CCAf]trading me on Steam[/url].


[h1]Credits[/h1]
I didn't create the artwork itself - I merely added a bit of programming magic to it. The artists's original work can be found below:
[b]Lake theme:[/b] http://louie.co.nz/25th_hour/
[b]Watchtower distant theme:[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1059450186
[b]Watchtower close-up theme:[/b] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FdPzO8Vlp2U
[b]Firewatch prologue:[/b] https://camposantogames.bandcamp.com/album/firewatch-original-score
